data.name: Bidhu
data.gender_notes: Bidhu is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Bidhu is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Vidh', which means 'knowledge'. It is a name that is deeply rooted in Hindu culture and is often given to children who are believed to possess great intellect and wisdom. The name Bidhu signifies intelligence, knowledge, and understanding. The name Bidhu carries the meaning “Intellect, Knowledge” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Bengali, Hindi. Parents who choose Bidhu usually hope their child will grow to embody intellect, knowledge and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Bidhu is a spiritual name that represents the pursuit of knowledge and wisdom. It is believed that individuals with this name have a deep connection to the divine and are destined to seek out the truth and share their knowledge with others.
data.etymology: Bidhu belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Intellect, Knowledge.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bidhu total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
